tools.name: calculate_payment_fees
tools.description: Exact JIM fee and net payout for a sale. Covers Tap to Pay vs Payment Link, fee pass-through, and JIM Card vs ACH withdrawal. Use instead of estimating.

amount_usd.description: Sale amount in USD, before fees.

method.description: Tap to Pay is contactless in person; Payment Link is sent remotely.

fee_paid_by.description: Who absorbs the processing fee. Default seller.

payout.description: How the seller withdraws. JIM Card is free. Default jim_card.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: JIM's pricing as structured data: account, processing rates, payout costs, Bookings, availability. Use calculate_payment_fees to price a specific sale.

topic.description: Which section to return. Default all.
